turns.speaker: AGT
turns.text: Namaste sir, bataiye kis tarah se main aapki madad kar sakta hoon?

turns.speaker: CUS
turns.text: Mujhe cheque book chahiye tha, aur dekh raha tha nominee Smart ke baare mein.

turns.speaker: AGT
turns.text: Theek hai, hum transaction Lite aur KYC Direct se process shuru karenge aur MorMudra check kar lenge.

turns.speaker: CUS
turns.text: Bas dhyaan rakhiye transaction Elite se kuch dikkat ho rahi thi, aur tokenised card ke liye bhi pooch raha tha.

turns.speaker: AGT
turns.text: Samajh gaya, JivMunafa aur RuvSugam ke saath know your customer Trust aur cheque book aapko jaldi bhej denge.
